from pathlib import Path
programs = Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u002/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source = '''def transform(grid):
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells) + 1
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells) + 1
    h, w = r1 - r0, c1 - c0
    return [row[c0:c0 + w // 2] for row in grid[r0:r0 + h // 2]]
'''

path.write_text(source)
